protocol.selection: Primary pairs use scheduled incoming arrival + GTFS station transfer and different-trip departures within +/-300 seconds, before inspecting outcomes. Secondary pairs center the same menu window on the actual traveler-ready time. Unresolved outcomes remain menu candidates.
protocol.information: Only the supplied incoming measured arrival and numeric forecasts received by that time. No other same-day actual endpoint is observed by the predictor.
protocol.theory: A shared additive day location with equal incoming/outgoing loadings cancels in the relative delay. Relative residual exchangeability across selected date blocks is still required. The residual includes minus the incoming idiosyncratic error, so cancellation does not establish coverage conditional on every particular incoming delay.
protocol.definition: Shrinkage uses zero-intercept constrained training-pair regression of centered outgoing on incoming delay and the corresponding empirical residual law. Heavy-tail uses independent route-centered incoming/outgoing role-noise KDEs plus a common zero-location Cauchy day effect; the incoming residual updates the day-effect posterior. Cauchy scale is the unscaled MAD of training-pair incoming residuals about their training median. No development value selects a parameter.
protocol.numerics: Base delta support [-300,3840] seconds, extended using the observed incoming residual and the fixed training-noise extrema plus nine kernel standard deviations. Exact anchor is included. Prior cell masses are Cauchy CDF differences. Likelihood and outgoing CDF use one-second tables. Outside-support unnormalized likelihood mass is bounded using the Gaussian nine-sigma density. Grid evidence is numerical, so its ratio is a diagnostic rather than a certified posterior bound.
protocol.local_joint_assumption: Given delta and route roles, centered incoming/outgoing noises are independent with the earlier KDE laws. The predictor conditions only on the rider-known incoming arrival. Arbitrary route-specific day loadings, serial day drift, and selection on unobserved outcomes are outside this local joint law. Canceled service remains a separate earlier route marginal.
